purpose: 补全独立桌灯工作台的方案保留体验：明确区分已保存、未保存、待选面及外部存档变化；当前标签内的页面跳转先提供继续编辑、先备份、核对保存后离开和明确放弃；检查文件、打开备份或下载入口不能冒充保存成功。

scope.otherStorageKeys: No hidden browser-storage inspection or mutation. The implementation and isolated storage fixtures address this workbench key; this run does not claim a browser comparison of the other ten workspace records.

historicalEvidence.meaning: Prior stale-page save, explicit latest-record adoption and asynchronous lifecycle evidence remains historical. The non-atomic storage guard is retained.
Prior three-table geometry, actual mouse-drag, native-file and actual disk-download records are retained. This draft-navigation run is not a new asset evaluation or a new actual disk download.

frozenPolicy.meaning: Source-triangle coverage, conservative collision checks and exact-raw storage protection are unchanged. Status equality does not replace any fingerprint or geometry validation.

draft.comparison: Canonical structural JSON state signatures; nested object property order and serialized whitespace do not affect equality, while array order and scalar types do.
draft.currentState: Only an accepted finite plain-JSON root object changes the retained signature. Null or undefined pending replies retain the last valid scheme.
draft.savedState: Caller marks a state saved only after verified initial stored-state loading, exact write/readback success, or explicit latest-stored-state restoration and baseline adoption. Merely exporting, checking or restoring another backup does not mark it saved.
draft.lateSave: A verified saved signature advances separately from the last observed current signature. Saving an older version cannot mark a newer current edit clean.
draft.distinctFlags: Pending face choice and active transaction stay separate from dirty geometry; a preview at its original value can remain an active gesture. An external-record event stays dirty until explicit verified save/adoption.
draft.rejection: Cycles, non-finite numbers, non-JSON values, non-plain prototypes, sparse/extended arrays, accessors/symbol fields and comparison limits reject atomically, preserving prior signatures and flags.
draft.isolation: Retained signatures are strings; mutating the supplied state or a returned flag snapshot cannot silently alter the observation or saved baseline.

ui.header: Current public status follows observed worker states, verified save/adoption and external change; camera changes do not create a dirty scheme.
ui.leaveProtection: Coordinator also protects pending selection, active gesture/transaction, in-flight work and unconfirmed save results. It cancels a current gesture before resolving an ordinary navigation request.
ui.ordinaryLinks: Primary unmodified self-target http(s) links leaving the current document are guarded. Same-document hashes, download links, explicit new targets and browser-owned modified-link actions remain available.
choices: Continue editing and preserve current scheme
Open a public backup on this page without saving
Save, require verified write/readback and no remaining protection, then navigate
Explicitly discard this page draft and navigate without saving
ui.pendingFace: Incomplete face selection disables save/backup from the leave dialog and directs the user to finish selection or Undo.
ui.cancelledIntent: Closing the dialog invalidates the pending navigation epoch; a late save result cannot unexpectedly navigate after the user returns to editing.
ui.verifiedFailure: Save rejection or changed readback opens save-problem flow, keeps the draft and blocks save-and-leave.
ui.externalChange: Another record change updates status but does not silently replace the displayed local scene. Latest full raw text must be checked and explicitly opened.

browserLifecycle.beforeUnload: A listener is attached while protection is needed and removed when clean or during explicitly chosen navigation. It requests the browser default reminder; no guarantee that the browser will display it.
browserLifecycle.pageshow: Resets the explicit-navigation suppression and refreshes protection. The actual tested back navigation cold-loaded the page; retained-page/bfcache behavior is covered only by the app VM event fixture.

storage.limitation: The retained localStorage read/compare/write/read guard detects controlled stale-page conflicts but is not an atomic compare-and-swap. This run does not establish truly simultaneous-write safety.

automatic.observation: Parent task executed the final complete suites. This evidence assembly independently counts new test definitions, checks historical byte hashes and recomputes public-state equalities; it does not rewrite historical reports.
draftCoverage: Initial unsaved state and verified saved baseline
Edit, Undo/Redo and preview cancellation by value
Null/undefined pending replies, distinct incomplete selection and active transaction
External change and explicit verified adoption
Late older save cannot make a newer draft clean; export/read alone cannot advance baseline
Nested key order, whitespace, array order and scalar type equality
Mutation isolation and invalid-input atomic rejection
Noncyclic shared references, null-prototype JSON and depth/node/aggregate text limits
addedActualAppVmCases: Status follows edits, rejection, Undo/Redo while camera changes stay clean
Backup export/check/open cannot certify saved status
Ordinary nested links guard drafts; browser-owned link actions stay available
Save-and-leave only navigates after verified storage and removes the duplicate native leave request
pageshow reactivates draft protection after explicit discard navigation
Closing a delayed save-and-leave invalidates navigation intent; backup stays on the page
Write rejection, readback change and stale record preserve draft and block navigation
External record event requires explicit adoption; Undo returns the former draft
Pending choice, active gesture and worker interruption retain protection without inventing a saved scheme
automatic.limits: The app tests execute actual app.js and draft.js coordination in a VM with controlled DOM, Worker, renderer and storage adapters. They establish code-level regressions, not actual browser native prompts, bfcache retention, pointer-hold or browser/device failure injection.

actualBrowser.method: Actual IAB visible controls and complete public JSON only; two sequential test tabs with actual cold returns/reloads. No hidden storage access, native dialog or persisted bfcache proof.
actualBrowser.storageInspection: Visible controls and complete public JSON text fields only; no hidden storage inspection or mutation.

steps.action: Nudge the lamp right 5 cm, then Undo and Redo.
steps.result: Edit and Redo show unsaved modification. Undo matches the whole initial text and shows the saved-consistent status.

steps.action: Use the project-progress link and choose Continue editing.
steps.result: Navigation is cancelled; the complete edited draft is retained on the workbench.

steps.action: Use the same link and choose Backup first; open a fresh observer tab.
steps.result: The public backup exactly equals the edited draft and has a download href, but the page stays dirty. The fresh observer loads the unchanged original record: backup did not autosave.

steps.action: Load the final app build, make the same edit and choose Save and leave.
steps.result: The full draft matches the earlier edit, then actual navigation reaches overview.html#next-steps only after verified save.

steps.action: Use actual browser Back to return to the workbench.
steps.result: Cold model loading is observed; the complete exported text equals the saved edit and status is clean. A subsequent edit and link attempt shows protection again.

steps.action: Inspect the older observer after the external save, then explicitly check and adopt the latest record before a confirmed reload.
steps.result: The old displayed scheme is retained instead of silently replaced. An early reload request did not establish a new document and still exported the initial text. The explicitly checked full raw equals the saved draft; after adoption, the confirmed safe reload exports that full draft. No native-prompt success is inferred.

steps.action: Select the retro table without choosing a face and try to leave; then Undo.
steps.result: The leave dialog disables save and backup and asks to finish selection or Undo. Undo restores the complete saved edit and clean status.
steps.incompleteChoiceExplanation: 先继续编辑并选择台面，或撤销回完整方案，再保存或备份。

steps.action: Open the original backup through public controls, then explicitly save.
steps.result: Restoration exports the whole original text while status remains unsaved. Only the later verified explicit save marks it saved.

steps.action: Make a separate left 5 cm draft and explicitly choose Directly leave without preserving changes.
steps.result: Actual navigation reaches overview.html#next-steps. The observer checks the latest complete stored text, which is still the original baseline: discard did not autosave.

steps.action: Return again through actual browser Back and read complete public text after cold loading.
steps.result: Final reopened and wide-layout public texts both exactly equal the original baseline and status is saved-consistent.

finalConsole.scope: Only the final primary test tab was inspected. No second-tab console result is claimed.

cleanup.originalPageChecks: Parent compared the original public 797-byte page and private 833-byte draft before/after through public fields. Only the private comparison outcome is published.

layout.reason: Requested 390×844 viewport did not take effect: both existing and temporary new tabs remained 1280 px wide. The override was reset and the temporary probe closed; no narrow/mobile screenshot is accepted as evidence.

actualBrowser.limits: Actual link navigation and cold re-opening are separate from native browser close/refresh prompts. A download href was observed, not a new disk download. Narrow asynchronous faults and simultaneous writes were not forced in the real browser.

publicArtifactVerification.distinction: Full text equality, UTF-8 lengths, envelope identities and controlled coordinate differences can be reproduced from the public artifact. Header labels, disabled buttons, navigation destinations, actual cold loading, layout, available href, console and excluded private-draft preservation are recorded UI observations.

artifacts.meaning: Actual desktop browser capture of unsaved navigation choices. The interface was unchanged during final pageshow/description updates and the final built main workflow was rechecked. Not an AI-generated image or native browser beforeunload prompt.
Complete public baseline, edited, undone, redone, backed-up, saved, adopted, reopened and restored texts plus recorded UI outcomes. The original private existing-page draft text is excluded.

sourceCodeSnapshot.hashing: SHA-256 over exact working-tree file bytes at assembly time without line-ending normalization; this identifies the observed source snapshot and does not claim identical Git-normalized blob bytes.
